user_task: Make routines of useful scraping APIs from the Premier League website

routine_specs.name: nav_base_pl_site
routine_specs.description: Navigate to premierleague.com English homepage and confirm core JS/config is loaded (window.PULSE.envPaths, ACTIVE_PL_SEASON_ID, SDP_API).

routine_specs.name: pl_standings_table
routine_specs.description: Fetch Premier League standings table for a given competition and season using Pulselive standings API.

routine_specs.name: pl_fixtures_by_matchweek
routine_specs.description: Fetch fixtures for a given competition, season, and matchweek using Pulselive matches APIs.

routine_specs.name: pl_teams_list
routine_specs.description: Fetch list of teams for a given competition and season using Pulselive teams API.

routine_specs.name: pl_team_profile_bundle
routine_specs.description: Given a team id, fetch core team details, form, next fixture, promo content, and media using Pulselive and api.premierleague.com content endpoints.

routine_specs.name: pl_player_profile_and_stats
routine_specs.description: Given a player id, fetch player profile and season stats for a given competition and season.

routine_specs.name: pl_match_details
routine_specs.description: Given a match id, fetch match events timeline and lineups.

routine_specs.name: pl_content_search
routine_specs.description: Search Premier League content (articles and videos) with filters like contentTypes, tags, and pagination.

routine_specs.name: pl_playlist_items
routine_specs.description: Fetch items for a given Premier League content playlist id.
